name: Tiled Parallel Compositing
definition: A compositing strategy where the framebuffer is divided into disjoint tiles, allowing parallel processing with zero synchronization, no atomics, and no locks, making it effective on CPU.
summary: Tiled parallel compositing partitions the framebuffer into disjoint spatial tiles for independent, lock-free parallel processing, distinguishing itself from atomic or data-partitioned methods by eliminating synchronization overhead.
